Both the lender as well its debenture trustee by implication, were therefore barred from the Committee of Creditors (CoC). The lender was not a promoter or a promoter's proxy. The first principle The IBC is not a recovery statute. But IBC chose a specific means of achieving revival: a CoC of financial creditors. items.title: My teen wants to play Grand Theft Auto 6. What do I need to know about the game?
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6, more commonly known as GTA6, is released on Thursday . I can’t wait to play. Neither can my 13-year-old. They’ve watched the trailers and the Netflix extended look . Their friends are talking about it. So are popular YouTube streamers. It’s easy to understand why they want to join in. What’s the game about? GTA6 follows the characters Jason and Lucia – a couple caught up in a criminal conspiracy. Think of a crime drama you can take part in. Game developer Rockstar’s character descriptions mention drug trafficking, prison and a strip club financed by drug money. It’s an open-world game, meaning players can explore activities between story missions . For players, that freedom is part of the appeal. But current trailers and game play videos reveal little about the surrounding story lines. Earlier games in the series show the range of adult content commonly featured. For example, GTA San Andreas , released in 2004, depicts paid sexual encounters and drug use. And GTA5, which came out in 2013, included a torture mission that made players carry out the violence.
